_comment: Deploy-artifact size budgets (bytes), enforced by check_deploy_artifact.mts. Baseline re-measured 2026-07-24 after deleting the TypeScript and standalone WASM engines and making all 55 Salsa-tracked Rust computations, exact invalidation evidence, and fail-closed dependency receipts part of the sole production runtime: total 10,685,935; runtime WASM 5,694,626; semantic-index WASM 2,099,237. Runtime and semantic-index WASM remain separate lazy chunks. Budgets retain roughly 5% headroom; raising one requires a named cause and a new measurement.
